rubric.KEEP: Community standard / CNCF graduated / Linux Foundation hosted. Adapter wraps for theoretical swap; no Phase 2 in-house replacement planned because this IS the standard.
rubric.VENDOR_REPLACEABLE: Phase 0 adapter wraps vendor; Phase 2 replaces with oya-<component>-server in-house native at a stated trigger.

vendor_replaceable_phase_2.rationale: Canvas surface is high-impact UX where oyatie wants control over rendering perf, accessibility, and Cedar-policy-aware node masking.

in_house_roadmap_addendum_2026_05_18.in_house_value_summary: Per the AWS/Google/Microsoft/Oracle pattern: oyatie's in-house engineering value lies in (1) the Cedar policy compiler that emits CNP + AuthorizationPolicy from per-µservice fragments, (2) the per-µservice CiliumNetworkPolicy templates, (3) the 8 canonical Kyverno ClusterPolicies, (4) the per-µservice OpenSLO sources + dashboards-as-code + alert routing, (5) the Rust workspace crate oya-client-shared-rust shared between Leptos Phase 2 + Linux GTK clients, (6) the OpenAPI 3.2.0 contracts as the cross-ecosystem unifier across all 5 native client stacks. These oyatie-native assets layer on KEEP-classified standard engines — exactly matching how the hyperscalers build on upstream.
